ArPI Webapplication

Purpose
- Frontend for the ArPI security system.
- Built as a localized Angular application with Ionic UI and Capacitor mobile packaging.
- Supports web, demo, remote-hosted, and Android/Capacitor deployment variants.

Primary files
- README.md: human-oriented project overview.
- package.json: source of truth for scripts, dependencies, linting, tests, and release helpers.
- angular.json: source of truth for build targets, output directories, localization, and environment file replacement.
- capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor app configuration.
- src/environments/: environment-specific runtime configuration.
- src/main.ts: browser entrypoint.

Technology
- Angular 21
- Ionic 8
- Capacitor 8
- TypeScript
- SCSS
- Karma/Jasmine for tests
- ESLint and Prettier for code quality

Safe commands
- npm install
- npm start
- npm test
- npm run test:ci
- npm run lint
- npm run format:check
- npm run build:remote
- npm run build:remote-dev

Important scripts
- npm start: start the Angular development server.
- npm test: run frontend tests.
- npm run test:ci: run tests without watch mode.
- npm run lint: run ESLint.
- npm run format:check: check Prettier formatting.
- npm run extract-i18n: update translation source files under src/locales.
- npm run create-package: create a production tarball from dist-production.
- npm run release:remote: publish remote builds using the existing script.

Build targets
- default development -> dist-development
- production -> dist-production, uses src/environments/environment.prod.ts
- demo-dev -> dist-demo-dev, uses src/environments/environment.demo.ts and src/index.demo.html
- demo -> dist-demo, uses src/environments/environment.demo.prod.ts and src/index.demo.html
- remote-dev -> dist-remote-dev, uses src/environments/environment.remote.ts and base href /v1-dev/
- remote -> dist-remote, uses src/environments/environment.remote.prod.ts and base href /v1/
- capacitor-dev -> dist-capacitor-dev, uses src/environments/environment.capacitor.ts and src/index.capacitor.html
- capacitor -> dist-capacitor, uses src/environments/environment.capacitor.prod.ts and src/index.capacitor.html

Working rules for agents
- Prefer commands already defined in package.json over ad hoc shell commands.
- Do not invent environment values; inspect the matching file in src/environments.
- When documenting or changing build behavior, verify against angular.json.
- Web and Capacitor builds do not use the same environment files or index files.
- Remote builds rely on base href configuration and are not meant to be served locally with the provided scripts.

External endpoints

- Documentation: https://docs.arpi-security.info/
- Remote app: https://app.arpi-security.info/
- Demo: https://demo.arpi-security.info/
